Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: repeat customer
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: The provider recognizes you as a returning customer and knocks a little off the price.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: quiet day
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: The settlement has spare capacity and completes the service faster.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: busy season
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: The settlement is busier than expected, and your service is taking longer to get to.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: word of mouth
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: Word spreads that you're a good customer to have around, and the settlement warms to you slightly.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: bad impression
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: Something about the exchange rubs the settlement the wrong way.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: complimentary service
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: The settlement throws in a little extra at no charge, as a courtesy.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: unexpected opening
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: A higher-tier appointment opened up at the last minute. Take it for a better outcome at extra cost, or stick with what you already agreed to.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: specialist unavailable
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: The specialist you were counting on is unavailable. Wait for them, or accept whoever is on hand at a discount.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: preferred customer
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: The settlement marks you down as a preferred customer before the work even begins.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: community request
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: Someone in the settlement mentions a small favor they could use help with someday.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.label: settlement upgrade
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Servi.description: Flush with the proceeds of a good trading run, the settlement invests in itself and remembers you were part of that windfall.
